case.summary: 1 transaction(s) totalling $59.67 on C09988-K1 are assessed as fraud (probability 0.99), matching card-not-present fraud from a device new to the account. Trigger: customer report. Tool calls: 8; closed cases consulted: none relevant. Rationale: Because the customer reported the transaction as unauthorized and the evidence confirms fraud, the bank’s policy (R2) mandates that the card be blocked. Likewise, the same policy clause (R2) requires a fraud case to be created to document and investigate the incident.
